name: @saqi/site
description: Public Astro site for the Saqi poetry corpus

scripts.schema:generate: yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso build && node --import tsx scripts/generate-database-schema.mjs
scripts.schema:check: yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso build && node --import tsx scripts/generate-database-schema.mjs --check
scripts.test: astro build --silent && node --import tsx --test tests/canonical-request.test.ts tests/catalog.test.ts tests/catalog-d1-adapter.test.ts tests/json-for-html.test.ts tests/metadata.test.ts tests/poem-translations.test.ts tests/public-cache-purge.test.ts tests/response-headers.test.ts tests/routes.test.ts tests/www-worker.test.ts && node --test tests/build-output.test.mjs tests/index-filter.test.mjs tests/search-normalization.test.mjs
scripts.audit:archive: yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso build && node --import tsx scripts/audit-archived-catalog.mjs
